t: This is Dorland House, a building in Westminster. It was designed by John James Joass, a British architect born in Dingwall in Scotland. His father, William Cumming Joass, was an established architect in that town, so Joass grew up in a family of builders and designers. He lived from 1868 to 1952. I don't have more detail about the building's history, so take a moment to look at its frontage and imagine the architect's Highland roots behind it.
